def make_ids(n: int, seed: int) -> list[int]:
    """n distinct record ids, identical on every run for the same seed.

    Ids are consecutive from seed % 1000000, so they are distinct and
    reproducible without any capability.
    """
    pre n >= 0
    post out.len() == n
    post {x for x in out}.len() == n
    ex make_ids(3, 10) == [10, 11, 12]
    ex make_ids(0, 5) == []
    ex make_ids(2, 1000000) == [0, 1]
    base = seed % 1000000
    out: list[int] = []
    for i in range(n):
        out.append(base + i)
    return out
